<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Click cross cells one at a time and observe changes
cross_cells = [(50, 30), (55, 25), (55, 35), (60, 30)]  # row, col

for i, (r, c) in enumerate(cross_cells):
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    
    # Check grid state
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    grid_state = {}
    hud_gray = 0
    for n in seg:
        b = n['boundary']
        if b:
            rmin = min(p[0] for p in b)
            cmin = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if 47 <= rmin <= 63 and 22 <= cmin <= 38 and n['pixels'] <= 20:
                grid_state[(rmin, cmin)] = n['color']
            if 16 <= rmin <= 24 and n['color'] == 'g' and n['pixels'] > 50:
                hud_gray = n['pixels']
    
    print(f"After click {i+1} ({r},{c}): gray_bar={hud_gray}, grid={grid_state}")
    if result.get('game_over') or result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Game state: {result.get('state')}")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
